text: sam: quick idea: introduce a "timeline rail" above the spend grid that shows daily density as compact bars and a row-level token card list below. goal: surface anomalies quickly. where should invoice actions live? inline per-row icon vs header export dropdown? nina: timeline rail is great for spotting spikes. question about discoverability on wide orgs with many rows. maybe stick per-row icon for the top 10 projects and move rest into "more actions". alex: prefer header export for bulk and per-row icon for frequent projects. mobile: per-row icon should be inside the accordion to save space. lia: a11y: timeline bars need non-color cues and detailed aria description when focused (e.g., "Peak on Mar 3: 120k tokens"). contrast and keyboard focus ring required. also ensure export dropdown is keyboard reachable and announces start/end (aria-live). sam: copy tweak: change metric label to "Estimated cost" instead of "Cost" when we show approximations. token card header = "Token usage". nina: UX variant idea: A/B test A: per-row icon visible + header export; B: header export only + per-row in kebab. Metrics: export completion time, support requests, clicks. alex: also ask product: can we show small invoice status badge (Paid / Pending) next to download to reduce confusion for finance? lia: snippet for aria-label for per-row download:
